pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(gayageum spark motif, distant jing, taepyeongso short call, first 10 seconds identity)
어둠은 Bye bye
손 들어, 더 높이
I’ll light you up

[Verse 1]
(sogeum cold wind texture, ajaeng low hold, light janggu steps)
어둠 속에 길을 잃을 때
멀리 빛나는 별 하나 없어
하지만 괜찮아
흐릿한 그림자만 네 곁에 남아
내가 다 밝혀줄게
내 손을 잡아줘
네가 넘어지지 않게
절대 안 넘어져

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum rhythmic strike, buk entering, female shout-ready)
내가 너의 등불이야
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게
Hey

[BUILD]
(taepyeongso rising phrases, janggu rolls, sharp kkwaenggwari, bass tension)
찬바람이 얼굴을 스칠 때
길 끝은 보이지 않을 때
두려워 말고
작은 희망조차 멀리 숨을 때
내가 다 찾아줄게
Run with me, 지금이야

[DROP]
(0.5 sec hush then instant bass + buk/janggu slam, jing hit, taepyeongso lead in 0.3 sec)
Light it up, Light it up
Burn it up, Burn it up
Turn it up, Turn it up
Light it up tonight

[Chorus]
(taepyeongso lead, punchy bass, female bright chant, male thick stack)
내가 너의 등불이야 Light it up, Light it up
어둠 다 태워버릴게 Burn it up, Burn it up
두려움은 던져버려 Turn it up, Turn it up
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게
Light it up, Li-li-light it up
등불이 될게
너만 보면 돼
손들고 같이 뛰어
Light it up tonight

[Verse 2]
(sogeum and gayageum, driving but open percussion)
내 목소리 들어봐
내가 곁에 있는 걸
항상 여기 있어
등불이 될게
너만 보면 돼
우리 같이 빛나자
내가 너의 빛이 될게
그럼 크게 외쳐봐
We are the light

[Rap Break]
(male aggressive low-register English rap, tight janggu/buk, kkwaenggwari hits)
No star on that road, I still showed
Hold my hand, you don’t fall no more
Cold on your face, I burn the fear
I am the lamp, I keep you near
Run with me now, don’t you hide
Darkness bye, we light the night
Fire in the sky, we don’t stop
We are the light, we light it up

[BUILD 2]
(taepyeongso fast riffs, double janggu, kkwaenggwari, bass swell)
하늘에 불꽃 터뜨려
내 손 놓지 마
우리가 바로 빛이야
Light it up tonight

[DROP 2]
(instant bass + Korean percussion, jing resonance, taepyeongso aggressive lead)
Light it up, Light it up
Fire it up, Fire it up
Forever up, Forever up
Light it up tonight

[Final Chorus]
(full ensemble, hook stacked, female soar, male power)
내가 너의 등불이야 Light it up, Light it up
세상 전부 밝혀버려 Burn it up, Burn it up
함께라면 뭐든 이겨 Turn it up, Turn it up
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게
Light it up, Li-li-light it up
너의 등불이야
내가 등불이야
우리 함께 Light it up, Light it up
Yeah, We are the light
I’ll light you up
I’ll light you up
I’ll light you up

[Outro]
(jing long bloom, gayageum last spark, bass tail)
어둠은 Bye bye
I’ll light you up
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
